given: checklists A and B on one vehicle inspecting the same item in the same place
an item kept in cabinets 1 and 4
older checklist versions that disagree about one item-place, and a deficiency whose place is unclear
an item requirement moved from cabinet 1 to cabinet 4 while an obligation pinned to cabinet 1 is in its window, and another requirement for the same item still kept in cabinet 1
when: a Supervisor publishes a checklist giving the shared item-place a different quantity
a crew member passes the shared item in the A session while someone has the B session open
the item passes and then fails in cabinet 1
a Supervisor changes the quantity of the item requirement
the migration runs as a dry-run, for real and again
a crew member checks the moved item at cabinet 4
then: the B session shows the item as done within the live-update targets
cabinet 4 stays due and clear, and only cabinet 1 needs attention with a deficiency naming its place
both checklists use the new quantity from its effective instant and earlier obligations keep their pins
the migration refuses until the conflict and the deficiency's place are resolved, then splits places, is idempotent and reads history the same
the open obligation is completed, it keeps cabinet 1 and the check records cabinet 4, and the other cabinet-1 requirement is not completed
notes: Language-neutral contract for draft SPEC amendment 6.0.0 (PR #254). The scenario is not yet bound to application commands.
